# pip-audit ignore list for services/preview (security-python CI job, M-25).
#
# One vulnerability ID per line (PYSEC-…, GHSA-…, CVE-…), followed by a
# comment giving the reason, the owner and a review date, e.g.
#   PYSEC-2024-0000  # not reachable: <why>; owner <name>; review 2027-01-31
#
# Each entry is passed to pip-audit as --ignore-vuln for preview only.
# Prefer bumping the pin in services/preview/requirements.txt; an entry
# here is an accepted risk that someone signs for. Empty on purpose: every
# known finding fails CI.
